title: Night Herd Waltz
short: Teddy Rook Book (original) · G 3/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: Cowboys on the old cattle trails took turns riding slowly around the herd at night, and they sang to keep the cattle calm. Many of their songs were slow waltzes like this one. Strum it with the waltz pattern: the thumb or pick plays the bass note of the chord on beat 1, then two light down strums. Then pick the tune, which never leaves the top three strings.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: A slow waltz written for this course in the style of old cowboy and campfire songs

sources.name: Original composition by Teddy Rook Book for this course (no source needed); the bass-strum waltz accompaniment is traditional.
